OSTC-T16.detail: Closed form U*=floor(K/(d-c))+1 matches the least searched crossover horizon on all 1,476 cells with d>c, zero mismatches. The phase diagram has two phases and both were enumerated: a further 1,476 cells with d<=c produced ZERO spurious dominance, so 'compiled dominates' is falsifiable on this grid rather than true everywhere by construction.
OSTC-T16.vector_caveat: 72 Pareto-incomparable cost-vector pairs exist for which no scalar crossover is defined, exercising the theorem's own limit that vector dominance is price-relative. Confirming only the scalar half would have reported support for a theorem whose stated caveat was never tested.

OSTC-T18.detail: Sufficiency and partition refinement are exactly equivalent over all 225 partition pairs on 4 elements, zero violations in either direction. The common refinement is jointly sufficient for every 2-family and no strictly coarser partition is, over all families examined.

comparator.detail: 165 fresh-but-insufficient states admitted and 60 stale-but-sufficient states refused. T18 says freshness is neither necessary nor sufficient, and both halves were observed. A donor erring only one way would have meant the enumeration never reached the claim.

what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing beyond the declared grid: K<=40, costs<=8, 4-element partitions. Total enumeration over a finite class, not a sample; no interval is computed.
No proof-assistant correspondence; EXEC-PA-01 remains open.
No external adjudication. Runner and checker are two implementations inside one programme.
